purpose: bounded paired synthetic GT-supervised STE-FlowNet diagnostic on one pre-registered textured indoor training layout and one independent validation layout; corrected launcher output paths; not formal training or generator ranking

model.name: STE-FlowNet
model.input: official five equal-event-count Gaussian-count temporal bins per polarity, 320x240 raster, symmetric zero padding to 352x352

scene_design.source: ReplicaCAD Interactive v1.5 apartment layouts instantiated and rendered in Genesis; not RGB-video reuse
scene_design.moving_object_template_rule: the sole ReplicaCAD object with exact basename 'frl_apartment_tvstand'; selected by initial renderer segmentation presence before EventGenesis or V2E generation
scene_design.renderer_segmentation: link-level renderer IDs remapped through Genesis entity/link table to physical link IDs
scene_design.flow_label: per-link SE3 projection with target depth visibility test, pixel displacement from t=0 to 30ms
scene_design.initial_visibility_gate: selected link must have >100 source segmentation pixels on shared geometry before motion; no generator event count used

initial_visibility_preflight.selection_basis: initial geometry renderer segmentation from pre-existing Genesis camera-motion runs, inspected before EventGenesis/V2E generation or model diagnostics
initial_visibility_preflight.renderer_id_to_physical_link_id: current Stage8 sc0 runtime mapping observed renderer ID 4 -> physical link ID 3 for the third registered rigid object; both scene configs use the same frl_apartment_tvstand at object index 2

data.split_unit: complete registered ReplicaCAD layout; no adjacent-window split

objective.type: existing four-scale robust endpoint error from Stage 5 synthetic GT pilot

diagnostic_budget.interpretation: one registered rollout is repeated for the bounded training fit; validation uses a different pre-registered layout. Fit is not independent-layout generalization or evidence of generator superiority.

evaluation_masks.primary_diagnostic: common union of normal-input EventGenesis and V2E active pixels intersected with shared GT validity, frozen before training
evaluation_masks.empty_active_mask: retain rollout and report null active-region EPE

sensor.profile: uncalibrated Stage-5 pilot values, fixed and identical for paired EventGenesis comparison; V2E consumes the same Genesis radiance endpoints

limits: one training and one independent validation layout, one 30ms camera-plus-selected object trajectory per layout
selected object trajectory is a scripted kinematic probe, not a calibrated natural-object motion distribution
diagnostic uses synthetic flow labels and does not replace the existing self-supervised formal objective
real datasets and real scores are excluded

resource_policy.gpu: atomically reserve and recheck only an idle unowned card; poll once per minute for up to five minutes after data creation
resource_policy.cpu_fallback: if no GPU appears, use the same two-thread CPU only when at least 16 CPUs, load1 <= 70% of CPU count, and MemAvailable >= 40 GB; both arms run on the same device
